headwordSources: Academic Word List (AWL) - Coxhead, 570 word families - free for educational use
TOEIC public sample materials (ETS open resources)
Common business English vocabulary - own curation

scoreBandPolicy.score-600: TOEIC 600 level - basic business English, GSL outside daily 300

_meta.topicPolicy: Each headword assigned ONE primary topic. Multi-topic words assigned to most-frequent context.
qualityNotes: Score-band boundaries are heuristic; calibration happens in 9b sample.
Topic assignment is best-effort; cross-domain words go to most-common usage.
Duplicates within bands and overlap with daily 300 are filtered by post-process script.

cleanupNotes.dedupRule: first occurrence by (band asc, topic specificity asc) wins

pass2Notes.rule: allowlist legitimate compounds; drop score-990 legal/general/academic as off-target for TOEIC
